# 4.1 Why packaging is a core GIScience skill

## Story problem

**Auckland utilities you can import in every project**

- You stop copying and pasting code between repos.
- Your join keys and CRS checks become standardised.
- Your analysis becomes easier to teach and review.

## What you will learn

- Module vs package vs distribution in everyday terms.
- Why packaging matters for Auckland workflows (teaching, labs, sharing).
- GIS pitfalls: CRS, binaries, and data size.
